properties.value: Transitive dep in the mobile bundle (via @iota/core's tooling chain); ships SHA-family JS hash implementations in the shipped app. Dependency inventory — how the build ships.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js@3.1.9-1 is a transitive dependency in the mobile yarn.lock (line 3562); its MD5 (and AES/SHA) implementations ship in the mobile bundle. No direct call site found in the application code. Dependency inventory entry — same package as the crypto-js library object.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Old crypto-js (2013) ships SHA-1/MD5/AES/DES JS implementations in the mobile bundle; no direct call site found in the app's own code (library surface present via dependency).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl 0.14.5 is imported in src/mobile/src/libs/crypto.js; Ed25519 (nacl.sign) capability ships in the mobile bundle — the app's observed tweetnacl use is secretbox (seed encryption), Ed25519 is available in the shipped library surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic 6.5.3 sits in the mobile dependency tree via the react-native-crypto polyfill chain (mobile package.json maps node 'crypto' to react-native-crypto; create-ecdh depends on elliptic). ECDSA/ECDH capability ships in the mobile bundle. The same package is pinned by 'resolutions' in src/mobile/package.json (elliptic >=6.5.3), a supply-chain pin applied after the elliptic 6.5.2 compromise — that pin is a governance artifact of this wallet.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 (nacl.scalar.mult, nacl.box key agreement) ships with the same tweetnacl dependency used for the seed secretbox; quantum-vulnerable key agreement (Shor).

Note the app's own at-rest encryption is AES-256-GCM (desktop vault) / XSalsa20-Poly1305 (mobile) — crypto-js AES is polyfill capability only; no direct call site found.

properties.name: pqs:context
